offering_description.value: Upbound leases household merchandise to consumers through its own stores, websites and participating retailers, with options to purchase. It supplies merchandise and licenses store formats to franchisees. It also offers cash advances, credit-building tools and budgeting features through a consumer finance app.

primary_products.value: Furniture; consumer electronics; major appliances; mattresses; computers

primary_services.value: Lease-to-own merchandise agreements; retail franchising; cash advances; credit building; budgeting and account monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households seeking flexible ownership and consumers seeking short-term cash or help building credit; B2B: Independent lease-to-own franchisees and retailers offering lease-to-own at checkout

end_markets.value: Home furnishings; consumer electronics; household appliances; consumer financial services

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Recurring payments under household merchandise lease-to-own agreements; product sales: Merchandise purchases by consumers and wholesale inventory purchases by franchisees; subscription: Paid app memberships for cash advances, credit building and money management; licensing or royalties: Franchise fees and royalties for use of store brands and operating systems
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sources finished household goods and leases or sells them directly to consumers; software / platform: Connects participating retailers and their shoppers through checkout technology that originates merchandise leases; service provider: Uses linked account data to provide consumers with cash advances, credit building and budgeting tools; distributor: Supplies sourced household merchandise to lease-to-own franchisees
value_chain_position.category: retailer; software / platform; service provider; distributor

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States and Puerto Rico, with lease-to-own stores in Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Store-based and virtual lease-to-own, retail franchising, cash advances, credit building and budgeting tools

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated lease-to-own stores; third-party retail: Participating retailers offering lease-to-own at in-store and online checkout; online: Company websites and a consumer finance app; partners / resellers: Independently operated franchise stores
distribution_channels.category: own locations; third-party retail; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State lease-purchase and cash-advance rules, plus federal consumer protection and credit reporting requirements

notes: The current extent of the store network in Mexico is uncertain.
